chunks: Abu Ali al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn 'Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan, from Ibn Muskan, from Badr ibn al-Walid, from Abu al-Rabi', from Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
Indeed, when the Imam desires to know, he is informed.

key_terms.أُعْلِمَ: he was informed; knowledge was conveyed to him
key_terms.الْإِمَامَ: the Imam, the divinely appointed leader

ai.seo_question: How does the Imam know what he wishes to know according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the Imam عليه السلام is granted knowledge whenever he wills to know. It points to a divinely bestowed mode of knowledge connected to the مقام of the Imam in Shia theology.
